title: 第163章 阴神出游融灵观想法的神奇效果第162章 变态肉身大法师之下谁能伤我
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
;;
苏辰嘀咕完，收起短刀，手掌再次一翻。
一只温润的白玉瓶出现在掌心。
瓶中装着的，正是先前得到的灵泉圣水。
【黄阶极品·灵泉圣水】
【蕴含纯净灵性，可修补神魂损伤，稳固识海，强化神魂，洗去阴邪力量对魂魄的侵蚀。】
苏辰轻轻晃动玉瓶。
瓶中清澈的液体随之泛起一圈淡金色涟漪，看着便让人心神宁静。
肉身已经得到了一次强化。
若再将灵泉圣水炼化，他的神魂同样能够迎来一次提升。
黄阶上品的好处都那么大，这极品的肯定会带来惊喜。
不过，刚才淬体消耗了不少精力。
此刻状态不佳，直接服用，未必能够将圣水的力量完全吸收。
苏辰深吸一口气，将玉瓶放在身前，重新盘膝坐下。
双眼闭合。
呼吸逐渐恢复平稳。
一刻钟后。
先前淬体积累的所有疲惫已经被驱散，精气神重新攀升至巅峰状态。
苏辰重新睁开双眼，他拿起白玉瓶，大拇指轻轻一挑，拔开瓶塞。
一股仿佛能洗涤灵魂的淡淡清香从瓶中飘出。

只是轻轻嗅上一口，他便感觉眉心一阵清凉。
神魂像是感应到了什么绝世美味，竟不受控制地传来一股极为强烈的渴望。
苏辰没有迟疑，仰头将灵泉圣水尽数饮下。
圣水入口之后，并未落入腹中，而是迅速化作一股银白灵力，散入四肢百骸。
随后，银白灵力沿着脊骨一路向上冲刺。
尾椎。
脊柱。
玉枕大穴。
最后如百川归海般，尽数涌入眉心泥丸宫之中。
轰！
苏辰脑海中仿佛响起一声惊雷炸响。
那一瞬间，他只觉得神魂被一股力量猛然托起。
视线随之拔高，穿透了肉身的阻碍。
等重新看清周围时，竟震惊地发现，魂体已经悬浮在肉身上方。
低下头，下方，身体依旧盘膝而坐。
一层圣洁的银白色灵光，犹如轻纱般笼罩在肉身的皮肤表面。
肉身与魂体之间，则有一缕若有若无的光线彼此相连。
源源不断的银白灵气沿着那道光线，涌入魂体之中。
原本还有些透明的魂体，在吸收这些力量后，开始迅速凝实。
手脚的轮廓。

After Su Chen muttered, he put away the short knife and turned his palm again.
A warm white jade bottle appeared in the palm of my hand.
What is in the bottle is the holy water from the spiritual spring that was obtained earlier.
[The best of Huangjie·Lingquan holy water]
[Contains pure spirituality, which can repair damage to the soul, stabilize the sea of consciousness, strengthen the soul, and wash away the erosion of the soul by evil forces. 】
Su Chen gently shook the jade bottle.
The clear liquid in the bottle creates a circle of light golden ripples, which makes people feel peaceful just by looking at it.
The physical body has been strengthened once.
If he refines the holy water of the spiritual spring again, his soul can also receive an improvement.
The benefits of high-grade Huangjie are so great, and this top-grade one will definitely bring surprises.
However, body quenching just now consumed a lot of energy.
The current condition is not good, and if you take it directly, you may not be able to fully absorb the power of the holy water.
Su Chen took a deep breath, placed the jade bottle in front of him, and sat down cross-legged again.
Eyes closed.
Breathing gradually returned to calmness.
A quarter of an hour later.
All the fatigue accumulated in the previous body tempering has been dispelled, and the energy and spirit have climbed back to their peak state.
Su Chen opened his eyes again, picked up the white jade bottle, gently picked it up with his thumb, and pulled out the cork.
A light fragrance that seems to wash away the soul floats out of the bottle.
Just taking a gentle sniff, he felt a coolness between his brows.
The soul seemed to sense some unparalleled delicacy, and an extremely strong desire came out uncontrollably.
Su Chen didn't hesitate, raised his head and drank all the holy water from the spiritual spring.
After the holy water entered the mouth, it did not fall into the belly, but quickly turned into a silvery white spiritual power that dispersed into the limbs and bones.
Then, the silvery white spiritual power rushed upward along the spine.
Caudal vertebrae.
spine.
Jade pillow large acupoint.
Finally, like hundreds of rivers returning to the sea, they all poured into the Niwan Palace between the eyebrows.
boom!
There seemed to be a thunderous explosion in Su Chen's mind.
At that moment, he felt that his soul was suddenly lifted up by a force.
The line of sight then lifted up, penetrating the obstacles of the physical body.
When he looked around again, he was shocked to find that his soul was already suspended above his physical body.
Lowering his head, below, his body was still sitting cross-legged.
A layer of holy silver-white spiritual light shrouded the surface of the physical body's skin like a veil.
Between the physical body and the soul body, there is a faint ray of light connecting each other.
A steady stream of silver-white spiritual energy flows into the soul body along the light.
The originally somewhat transparent soul body began to solidify rapidly after absorbing these powers.
Outline of hands and feet.
